clock: Process CPU user+system via clock_gettime(2), wall Instant, entire loop. Checked sums and clock failures return failure.
input_boundary: Only workload.request.input; expected projections/source IDs are not read
local_reset: Eval: actual PawnCache clear, stats reset and new Node each invocation, fixed RootContext remains bound. Position: copy initial then all actual native moves. Search: existing run_seeded_iterations clears learning/PawnCache/TT and resets work every sequence; generation wrap scans remain charged.
opaque_inputs: black_box initial Position, predecoded moves and mutable typed sink

prior_failed_source_attempt.reason: Overstrict Cargo.toml newline assertion before any mutation; inspected dcb58e/0 and corrected preparation assertion only.

scope_limit: Search physical storage provisioned once; owned-call includes native root preparation, unlike narrower reference controlled-call. Compare enclosing scope only with explicit allocation/reset differences. Typed observation buffers reused and last observation retained for cold serialization/guard cleanup.
search_callback: All raw returns captured in original visitation order. Final slice pairs last Iteration.candidates, never post-ranking roots; no fullTrace
typed_consumer: All selected fields including chronology/phase/identities/retained/reuse/finishing/work/root results are folded every invocation; no JSON in local clock
unsafe_scope: Only audited Linux64 clock_gettime FFI, two process-clock reads/batch; no unsafe engine/state operations
